title: The sequence, re-ranked
summary: The first page of the Rebuild Sequence beside its section head (a claim the table proves: something comes off the list every quarter): how items move, then Exhibit 1, the ranked table (Rank · Item · Last quarter · Decision · Why) for an illustrative quarter; under the page, in its own quiet place, the one Lab line (Q4) with its kit link.

reference.borrowed: Running head, numbered section, a captioned exhibit, a folio.
reference.kelwin: Specimen once in the running head; illustrative company, no figures that read as results.

motion: entrance: the head rises (kit); the six table rows rise in turn.
notes: Round 9 fix: the head no longer says what the sheet's section says; 're-ranked' is gone; the single section carries no number and the folio is 1; the Lab line moved here from 'Who runs it' (no link stack) and reads 'coming soon, by invitation'. Coherence pass: the Lab line is a pointer (“Our R&D, the Lab, is building the platform this loop will run on.”); the sheet's company is the readout specimen's invented company, and its new item is the healthcare narrative the readout questioned.
